name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Senior Manager, Back End Engineering
summary: Engineering leader with 25+ years of software delivery experience spanning people and technical leadership, back end architecture, and hands-on development. Has managed and mentored engineering teams, led modernization and integration initiatives, and partnered with product owners, stakeholders, and distributed teams to deliver business-critical systems. Brings deep Java, C#/.NET, API, SQL, cloud, and CI/CD experience, with a practical focus on team effectiveness, engineering quality, security, and reliable delivery.

Engineering Leadership & Delivery: Roadmap Planning, Sprint Planning, Backlog Prioritization
Backend Architecture & Engineering: Client-Server Architecture, REST APIs, Microservices, Schema-Driven Design
Asynchronous Processing, Multithreaded Systems, Atomicity, Eventual Consistency, Message Bus Architecture
Platforms, Quality & Reliability: Automated Testing, Cucumber, BDD, Unit Testing

jobs.title: Senior Manager
details: Engineering Leadership & Delivery

• Established team working agreements and Scrum delivery practices for a resource-constrained team, partnering with Product Owner and Scrum Master to balance roadmap commitments with urgent business needs
• Onboarded engineers across experience levels, conducted code reviews, and provided technical guidance on architecture and quality
• Introduced production release management practices using MS Planner, OneNote, Jira, and Confluence to improve release qualification and delivery coordination
• Led modernization of a legacy production application, launching the first clients in under 9 months through iterative delivery
Architecture & Technical Direction
• Designed and implemented Java 17/Spring services using CQRS, SOLID principles, and API-first integration patterns
• Improved API-driven design by decomposing monolithic schemas into atomic units and using Redocly for compliance submissions
• Designed operational sequences and service flows using C4 templates in Mermaid
Quality, Security & Reliability
• Partnered with the test automation team to define BDD coverage for complex integration workflows and integrate execution into CI/CD
• Established mocked integration and end-to-end Cucumber tests, along with supporting utility applications
• Migrated two APIs from Bitbucket to GitHub and established CI/CD pipelines
Technologies: Java 17, Spring, Cucumber, GitHub, CI/CD, Redocly, Jira, Confluence
